• **AI Spotlight**: Something’s off with Midjourney’s pivot to body scanners
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Scattered Spider members plead guilty to hacking Transport for London
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch, Krebs on Security and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
